name: car_hyper drive modes
source: [AS] Q3 / I8 (queue item, docs/next_steps_brief.md): car_hyper's drive modes. Eco, Sport and Racing copy car_hyper_n2o's part (drive_modes_car_hyper_n2o.json: owner-approved Eco/Sport values, Racing [AS] - see its source). Normal overrides NOTHING (no bend, the car's own manual_tcu shift points 2500/8000/1300/3500 and close 0.1 s, no TC or LC default, LC allowed as before), so car_hyper in its default mode drives bit-identically to the car without the part - the launch control of its Racing assist unit keeps working in Normal as before (open owner decision: car_hyper_n2o's Normal does NOT allow LC). nitrous_arm_allowed is inert (no kit). epb_mode: park_only in Eco / Normal / Sport, handbrake in Racing.
